summary.headline: Advantia Health secures $716K in verified annual savings across 6 spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ strategic-sourcing engagement delivered $684,936 in fully-finalized annual savings from five high-impact categories and has a further $31,459 in savings moving toward implementation for IT Managed Services. Key wins included a 9% fee reduction on Billing/RCM with Athena, a 14% cut in Medical Supplies via distributor consolidation, and an in-house Sonography staffing model delivering 19% savings. All savings are recurring and begin phasing in as early as July 2022.

impact.operational_improvements: Engagement standardized purchasing behaviors (e.g., minimum IUD order quantities), consolidated medical-supply distribution, and transitioned sonography staffing in-house, resulting in improved inventory visibility, faster recruitment cycles, and streamlined invoice processing.

proof_points.statement: Negotiated Athena billing fees down to 3.15 %, generating $259K in annual savings without changing platform.
